title: Build, Run, and Environment Configuration
learningObjectives: Distinguish build steps from running the program
Use safe configuration for sensitive values
Verify a clean setup can build and run

understand.concept: Build and run processes transform source or prepare assets and execute the program. Environment configuration provides settings such as mode, endpoints, or feature flags. Configuration should be explicit, documented, and safe; secrets should be supplied through protected mechanisms and never embedded in committed source.
understand.whyItMatters: Reliable workflow and collaboration practices help people coordinate changes, manage risks, and maintain a working project.
understand.analogy: A shared team task benefits when each person understands their responsibility and the agreed steps.
understand.analogyLimit: Development tools and version histories have technical behaviors that this teamwork analogy does not capture.

explain.narrative:
Build and run processes transform source or prepare assets and execute the program. Environment configuration provides settings such as mode, endpoints, or feature flags. Configuration should be explicit, documented, and safe; secrets should be supplied through protected mechanisms and never embedded in committed source.

Use these practices as a practical guide, adapting them to the repository, language, team, and risk level. Make the intended changes visible and verify them rather than relying on assumptions.
